cases.given: Registered active org; own authorized relayer; fresh case/event; sequence=1; schema=1; nonzero commitment
cases.assertions: One CaseVerified; correct owner/verified/sequence; stored payload digest; exactly 4 topics and 128 data bytes

cases.given: Unknown caller; also repeat against an existing eventId
cases.assertions: Authorization fails before event/case lookup; no state change or event

cases.given: Admin has DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE but is not explicitly authorized relayer

cases.assertions: No write; exact error precedence remains proposed

cases.given: Org B relayer calls for org A; separately org B authorized caller tries case owned by A using fresh eventId
cases.assertions: Caller mismatch rejected; cross-org case ownership rejected

cases.given: Previously authorized relayer revoked; valid payload
cases.assertions: No state change, including when replaying a stored eventId

cases.given: Fresh case with chainSequence=0 and then 2, each in isolated setup
cases.assertions: First sequence must be 1; no event/state change

cases.given: Already verified case; new eventId; next sequence
cases.assertions: Case verification cannot be recorded twice

cases.given: Replay T01 exactly with same eventId and digest
cases.assertions: No second event/state update; worker validates original successful receipt/log, never confirms the reverted retry

cases.given: Same eventId; change one of commitment/caseRef/sequence; maintain authorized org context and structurally valid values
cases.assertions: Compare digest before new-case transition guards; original stored record unchanged. Unsupported schemaVersion is a separate validation rejection before duplicate lookup under the proposed guard order.

cases.given: Same eventId with changed orgRef; caller NOT authorized for target org
cases.assertions: Do not promise EventIdConflict before authorization; use a caller authorized for both orgs for isolated cross-org digest-conflict test

cases.given: Zero org/case/event/commitment; schema 0 or 2; invalid uint widths at encoder boundary
cases.assertions: No write; distinguish ABI encoder rejection from contract guard

cases.given: Inspect calldata/log fields; marker PII/private URL/salt injected in private fixture
cases.assertions: Only envelope and block timestamp public; fixed salt test input never copied to real records; no payable call

cases.given: Null receipt, status=0, wrong chain/address/topic/eventId/commitment/sequence/schema or removed log
cases.assertions: Business VERIFIED persists; chain proof missing/mismatched; no fabricated transaction evidence

cases.given: Restart after prepare/broadcast/mining or DB receipt save failure
cases.assertions: Exact signed bytes/hash/nonce preserved; recover original event; do not regenerate eventId/salt

cases.given: Java and TypeScript encode the same golden-vector input plus Unicode/order/mutation cases
cases.assertions: Canonical UTF8, SHA256, ABI bytes, Keccak commitment/payloadDigest and decoded fields agree

cases.given: Same eventId and same envelope reused through a different milestone function
cases.assertions: Operation-bound digest required; C01-only implementation cannot establish multi-function compatibility
